Nominal Mg10Si3O14(OH)4, 35 atoms/formula unit and Z=2. Litasov et al. (2007) infer LT polymorph from synthesis/measurement temperatures, without a full in-situ structural refinement. Independent diffraction model: Koch-Müller et al. (2005) Table 4, MKM0105 Pnn2, with author-corrected O6 and official 2014 H2 erratum. Retain the structure-source a=14.024, b=5.109, c=8.733 Å orientation (a/b exchanged relative to Litasov). This ideal fully occupied structural proxy is not the EOS specimen and is not rescaled to fitted V0. H2 is an IR-derived positional estimate. Distinct from Al-bearing Xu (2024) superhydrous phase B.
